[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Gate `@` reference file rows behind kind misses and explicit Ctrl+T[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The grouped `@` reference menu lists local file rows only when no [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]artifact kind prefix-matches the typed text, or when the user [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]explicitly asks for them (`Ctrl+T` in the ACE prompt, a manually [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]invoked completion request over LSP). The rule is decided once in [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the shared Rust core so the TUI and every LSP client agree.[/#D7D7AF]
